svg.title: How it works · the night shift
svg.desc: Research at 01:00 fills the inbox, memory at 02:00 promotes notes, skills at 03:00 mines patterns, interaction at 04:00 puts prompt rewrites before an A/B judge, evolve on Sundays at 05:00 writes proposals.
svg.text: HOW IT WORKS · THE NIGHT SHIFT
Plus: compress every hour, autoheal every six hours, autoupdate on Mondays. 90-Meta/STOP halts all.
